title: Kiss Of Darkness

The wall behind the portrait opens, and the woman’s eyes seem to tell you to walk forward, into the opening, and into the mist.

It has become a compulsion now to just follow the swirling, mesmerizing mist as it leads you down the spiraling stairs, deeper down, out of reality, and out of the world behind you.

You’re compelled to lie down on the old wooden torture table, which straps you down on it’s own, as if controlled by some unseen force.

Everything is quiet.  Everything is soft, and you feel a heaviness and warmth spreading across your chest and stomach.  The silver mist is swirling over you, forming into a solid shape.  As you blink you find yourself staring deep into the eyes of the woman from the portrait.

She has lured you into her dungeon, and now you are hers!
